assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single production transparent PNG bucket sprite for a mobile sand-sorting game.
Reference image: the user's MOST RECENT attached screenshot showing FOUR buckets, red, yellow, green, blue in one row. Use the FIRST / leftmost red bucket as the precise visual reference.
Primary request: recreate ONLY that red bucket as a separate asset, matching its screenshot geometry, color palette, view angle and simple smooth mobile-game shading as closely as possible. The screenshot's numeric 800 is a dynamic game label: remove it, leaving a completely blank front.
Geometry: same squat rounded-square open tub seen slightly from above, broad gently rounded rectangular top opening with shallow interior, a thin rounded bright lip, short smooth softly tapered front and round bottom corners. No handles. Match the screenshot's outer width/height ratio approximately 145:118. Do not enlarge the rim, deepen the cavity, add ridges, or change the shape.
Colors: vivid warm coral red lower body, soft salmon red interior; main front wall approximately #FF3936, interior approximately #FF7D74. Keep the screenshot's simple soft gradients and small pale rim highlights. Do not add dark shadows or extra surface texture.
Composition: exactly ONE upright centered bucket, complete and uncropped, with a small even fully transparent margin on all sides. Use the same proportions as its original screenshot. Preserve a fully blank front.
Background: true transparent alpha, with exterior pixels exactly alpha zero and a clean antialiased silhouette. No pink backdrop, no ground, no cast shadow, no glow, no checkerboard baked in.
Text: none. No 800, no digits, no symbols.
Avoid: other buckets, row arrangements, colored specks or fringes outside the bucket, heavy shiny reflections, photorealistic texture, logos, watermark, decorations, particles.
